summary: Mountain biker suffered a broken arm in a crash at West Magnolia, at roughly the same time as the Father's Day weekend Skywalker Couloir skier incident; Capt. Nick Faes and Iain Irwin Powell treated and stabilized the patient at the scene and walked them off the trail to the ambulance.
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE — pinned to Father's Day weekend 2024 (2024-06-16 = Sunday, verified) via the article's explicit 'at roughly the same time as the incident with the backcountry skier' anchor (the Skywalker Couloir fall = id 2688, dated 2024-06-16 from the same article). Run-585 parked this item; inserted now with the weekend anchor. Distinct from id 3197 (2014-07-04 West Magnolia Matthew Chan crash).
